reviews.title: Warning ⚠️ - Horrific Experience
reviews.text: Putting aside covid regulations in China at the moment, that we followed and continue to follow without hesitation. We were absolutely gobsmacked to have endured the level of negligence that we experienced on this flight and with this airline. Hands down the worst experience we have ever had, they should re-brand and call the airline ‘unlucky air’. It all started with a desperate attempt to return to our home in Chengdu, being quarantined for 7 days the week before, we were ready to get back to our lives. Under the misdirection of an agent, who assured us that she had phoned the airline and we were 100% going to be able to transit to our following flight in Kunming, the following occurred: We boarded the plane and flew business class for the first time, expecting it to be a wonderful experience, there was not one air hostess that could speak English and as we later found out, we were the only foreigners on the plane. We sat waiting to take off for more than an hour, the actual flight with regard to taxing, take off, turbulence handling and landing were all unusual and disturbing experiences. The fun began when we landed… while packing and getting ready to disembark, we were informed by a fellow passenger that we had to wait for 2 hours (without food or drinks) because we where going to be quarantined in Kunming. To our absolute surprise, the regulation must of changed while we were in the air, we waited for further instruction which never arrived…. After a 2 hour wait without any official communication, the air hostess spread horrific rumors of us having to quarantine in dormitories with no bathroom facilities and that the length of stay was much longer than anticipated. Bare in mind we have never traveled to Kunming before and had no idea what to anticipate. All of a sudden we were rudely told to disembark onto airline buses, shouted at in Chinese and ostracized for asking questions that could not be answered. Through out this process, no one could answer the simplest of questions “where are we going?”, we had Chinese colleagues and friends phone in a desperate attempt to find out what was going on and where we were going but all failed attempts. Reluctantly we got up and tried to disembark the plane, without the help of our friend that previously translated the rumors, we were stranded without any form of communication. The same air hostess (male) who started the rumors had walked off the plane with my phone in hand, no information was given to the agent on the other end and he processed to scroll through my images on his leisurely stroll back to the plane. Long story short… we got onto a bus to the middle of no where that took us 1h30 to disembark at our quarantine hotel for the next 3 days only to be informed that we were not accepted at this hotel as foreigners and should never have been in this situation, we were supposed to transfer as informed but because of the gross negligence experienced by the airline and their staff who were unwilling to help or communicate with us but could manage to create a group for the Chinese passenger’s who knew exactly where they were going and for how long.
reviews.author: Mandi Bezuidenhout

reviews.title: If cost is an issue you could do a lot worse
reviews.text: Hot tip! By flying from a smaller airport, in this case Mianyang, I saved over 1000¥. Other benefits were no queues and no delays. Lucky Air, charges for checked in luggage. So my fully loaded case (for 2) was a bargain really at 150¥. They also have narrow seats, minimal legroom and no menu. I totally understand that they are a budget airline and these things are luxuries that can be nonessential to a trip. This flight was on time, the plane was modern and clean, the staff polite, and all processes went smoothly. What, then could you complain about?
reviews.author: MattwalesNorthWales

reviews.title: Blacklisted
reviews.text: Since the moment I was queuing for my check-in I realized something weird was going on. Just next to the counter there was another counter whose only function was the one to get extra money from their customers. Once it was my turn the first thing I was asked from their employee was to pay a 200 RMB fine at the aforementioned counter as my small size trolley was too "bulky". I wasn't into arguing therefore I paid was I was asked to pay. At the same time I drew my conclusion to include Lucky Air among my blacklisted flight companies. As for the travel in itself it was kinda uncomfortable as there was a limited room for legs. Since it is a low cost company I correctly assumed the meals wouldn't have been for free, which is something I can accept for an hour or two-hour long journey. But in my case it was a five-hour long journey. Anyway...I don't mind. I am done with "un"Lucky Air.
reviews.author: Gorgan

reviews.title: Predatory baggage policy
reviews.text: At the security line, we were told our carry on bags had to be checked. When we went to check them, they forced us to pay RMB890 for our bags. Had to be cash or WeChat, no credit card. This was happening to everyone with Lucky Air and others were not happy. I called customer service and asked how much the checked bag should cost and the agent said they could not find out how much checking a bag from JHG-XIY should cost. They repeatedly said they are a low-cost airline, but their flights are more than competitors. Avoid at all costs. Tried to get a refund, but they said it was their policy and couldn't be changed. Note that this info was not available when booking my flight on Trip.com, it only said free checked bags 7kg. On the flight they made me take off my headphones with 40 minutes remaining, but when we landed (a landing so hard that everyone gasped out loud) others were up and walking around while we were still slowing down on the runway. Flight attendants were very inconsistent.
reviews.author: js

reviews.title: Worste plane flight, even worse service
reviews.text: Return flight was cancelled, ground staff where they have service desk, don't know what to do and how to refund. Not even helped for rebooking. Their headquarters is in Kunming, how is it possible they couldn't helped me in Kunming? The plane ride (to go to kunming) with lucky air is all the time bumpy. During the entire flight you will not shake for about 3 minutes. They choose the perfect airline name: LUCKY airline, If you are lucky, you will get at your destination and if you are lucky lucky,you will get there in 1 part.
reviews.author: Suleyman

reviews.title: Just like any other budget airline
reviews.text: It's just like any other budget airline whereby you'll need to pay for both your food and drinks. Pre-ordered food can be done online but payment is still via cash (RMB) during the flight. Tips:- The noodles taste better than their rice. Take off was a little shaky....which I think is due to the air-craft. Food service is extremely slow. The only reason I took the flight is due to it being a direct flight from Kuala Lumpur to Lijiang.
reviews.author: Cath2015

reviews.title: Flight Cancelled
reviews.text: Flight was cancelled for no apparent reason. When I asked they said it was part of the companies plan. Almost no notice given. Refund was short about 100RMB for whatever reason. If you complain their English gets worse and worse until you just accept it. Beware budget Chinese airlines.
reviews.author: Brandon L

reviews.title: Want a shaky plane ride? This is it.
reviews.text: Musty plane smells, zero air steward service, and a shaky plane ride from start to finish. Just the type of airline to avoid unless the price is dirt cheap.
reviews.author: Kheng

reviews.title: 服务有点差
reviews.text: I didn't really like the service, the way the stewardesses treat passengers. They were not really rude, but I felt like being in a kindergarden surrounded by some annoying supervisors. During the flight I always listen to music - there's nothing else to do on plane, and besides, it reduces stress for my ears, because they get quite sensitive to high latidudes, and sometimes it even cause a headache. But the girls instisted on removing the earphones, although my cellphone was already turned off. Other air companies are usually fine with that. I just didn't like this kind of requests and attitude. I mean, it's just f-cking annoying. The only thing I enjoyed was the ticket price - only 750 RMB from Thailand to the westernmost of China!
reviews.author: Satoshi Wng

reviews.title: Holiday in Lijiang
reviews.text: Flight was on time and with friendly crew. Food is not good. Lucky air is acceptible at this price. 👍
reviews.author: Freedom402275

reviews.title: My bag is heavily damaged
reviews.text: My bag is heavily damaged by the transport of this company. Has not received compensation Until today, waiting for 7 months until today, it is not helped to facilitate from your office in Thailand. And still allow us to contact the office in China, even though we have language problems Feeling very disappointed with your airline journey. Both I like China a lot. But very sorry to see this kind of incident Need clarification
reviews.author: katemade

reviews.title: Very happy
reviews.text: A short flight, on time, efficient check in, professional staff. Wouldn’t hesitate to fly with Lucky Air again.
reviews.author: NswAustraliaDidi

reviews.title: On time flight
reviews.text: We travelled end of December 2018 to Lijiang. Early departure and arrival, big portion of food but the food is oily. and good service
reviews.author: ISa B

reviews.title: First time, Delay 3 hours without Unusual weather
reviews.text: First time, Delay 3 hours without Unusual weather. Check-in time 16.00 - 18.00 Normal time: 18.45 Flight delay at 21.40 I guess they are delaying because low amount of passengers. And combined with another flight. There's no meal in flight. The airline is like low cost but the price is not. My first time, So lucky (air)
reviews.author: kijjaphot

reviews.title: Slow service at check in counter
reviews.text: It was our 1st time trying lucky air... Why Lucky air? coz we planned to go to Shangri-la from Lijiang... They recently started the service from KLIA, the check in KL counter was no issue, everything was smooth but during our flight back to KL from kunming by Lucky air it was very disappointing, we were queuing for almost 2 hours in individual check in lane, but somehow person infront us was check in for groups n the counter lady don't even bother to ask them to move to group check in lane. 2 hours in line when we are only the 4th from da front definitely not acceptable.
reviews.author: NorFarhana86

reviews.title: Budget Airline for short distance flight
reviews.text: I traveled from Kuala Lumpur to Lijiang. It took about 4 hours. A bit lower grade from Air Asia. But its ok. The meal on board not tasty. The one i appreciated the most is the free small bottle of mineral water. As the cabin crew not very fluent in english. They did not ask me whether i want to order food or not. So make sure pack some sandwich or biscuits. The entertainment system aired only on my way back to Kuala Lumpur. There are few small tv. The movie i watched quiet interesting.
reviews.author: norlelaahmad85

reviews.title: BEST PENANG KUNMING BUDGET AIRLINE
reviews.text: We were never impressed by any budget airline including the well known Air Asia which only budget on services and name only, until we took a return flight direct from Penang Kunming, The plane is clean and spacious, friendly flight attendances, free 17kg check in luggage, free mineral water, blanket and pillow. You don't have to board the plane under scorching sun and rain like Air Asia. You board the plane like any premium airline via passenger bridge like a VIP. Best still it is direct from Penang, we don’t have to transit in a few airport. Hope this air line continue its excellent services and provide air traveler the opportunity to travel economically with pleasure.
reviews.author: Guatleng

reviews.title: Good Budget airline
reviews.text: As this is the only flight from Kuala Lumpor to Li Jiang. I have no choice but to take the flight. It turns out to be way better then I expected. The seat has more legs room then a lot full service flight. The meal sold onboard are limited to only 2 choice and both does not taste good. My luggage did not arrive with me in Lijiang and was informed that it is left in Kuala Lumpor. Not sure if this is the airline error or the airport error. But I only get my luggage after 2 days. Because they do not have daily flight. Was compensated RMB200 which is less then my 1 piece winter wear that i need to buy. Would have given a four star experience if it is not for the misconnected luggage.
reviews.author: Alex Soo

reviews.title: Better than the name implies
reviews.text: I guess the name is to appeal to Chinese fascination with good luck. For westerners it makes you think you will lucky if you reach the desired destination. I choose this airline to get to Bangkok from Jinan, Shandong mostly during the day and to land at Bangkok international (BKK) rather than Don Mueng (DMK) To do that it was two flights with the first landing at Kunming, Yunnan and the total time was about 8.5 hours. Many flights to DMK from China arrive in the early hours of the morning and the immigration queues can be just what a sleepy traveller doesn't want. The service was fine and slightly better on the domestic first flight. The planes are modern Boeing 737s and the crew speak OK English. The onboard meals are the Chinese version of TV dinners and of course, are not free. The planes leave on time which is great for China. Their trick is to start boarding early which made them ready for takeoff punctually. In fact, the entire check-in procedure is slick compared to many I have suffered in China. You have the usual cramped legroom and lack of entertainment but hey it's a budget airline and the price was irresistible. They are not hard-nosed about the luggage allowance like the Thai airlines that fly from China
reviews.author: Instantcalmer

reviews.title: Cheap but narrow seats
reviews.text: It was simple budget airlines with cheaper fare, there is nothing of entertainment on board, except sleeping. Also the seat were so narrow, the board was not cleaned before the flight.
reviews.author: Sam

reviews.title: Good budget airline
reviews.text: Good Budget airline direct from KL - Lijiang only run 3 times a week currently, at alternate day, Mineral water & cake provided on KL - Lijiang and Rice & Mineral water included in the return flight. Leg room as budgeted. No In-flight entertainment, but is better then any other budget airline that i took before. Worth for money.
reviews.author: withjoey

reviews.title: Just Another LCC - Lucky Air
reviews.text: 30 of us golfers flew from Kuala Lumpur to Kunming, 3rd week of April 2018, return leg Kunming to Kuala Lumpur, end of 3rd week of April 2018. All of us flew with Lucky Air for the first time, but mostly had flew with different LCC - low cost carrier - before, thus we are able to compare and contrast. Overall, it was an average, at best, rating for an LCC trying to make it and be sustainable in an ever increasing crowded Asian market. Each leg of the journey took approximately 3.5 hours, not too long, not too short. We have absolutely no complaints about the hardware - the workhorse Boeing 737-800 aircraft utilized. It looks newish, the cabin is clean, legroom is adequate - though woe betide awaits a 6 footer person, cabin crew are polite and engaging, the announcements were audible and understandable - just -, the cockpit crew made creditable landings. Two complaints, and its applicable to both legs of the journey. 1. No food was sold on board as advertised and represented. 2. There were no facility for group check-in. We were expecting some snacks, light food, just to tide us over until we reach the destination. Regrettably there were none. 3.5 hours is just long enough for the stomach to sit up and take notice. The return leg, we were provided with a cucumber bun sandwich. But 330 ml mineral water were aplenty. Lesson learnt, bring some snacks on board, to munch during flight. Another peeve, there were no group check-in facilities at both ends of the airport. Apart from us, it seems that majority of the rest of the passengers were traveling with tour agents. Very minimal Free Independent Travelers. And the flight was 90-95% full. So, the question is, which demographic profile is Lucky Air - and maybe its parent Hainan Airlines - are targeting? Undoubtedly Yunnan Province has a total population of approximately 70 million, as we were told, there's no shortage of potential passengers. However, at the infancy of the KUL-KMG route, wouldn't the airline want to fill up the aircraft as much as possible all of the time? And what would be easier than to round up travel agents and sell sight seeing tours at both ends, plus the odd golf junket as a bonus.I would imagine the Independent Travelers would come when the route is sustainable and established. Yet Lucky Air seems to be alienating its very core demographic profile passengers by not providing Group Check-In Desk. I wish you all the best when flying with Lucky Air.
reviews.author: Ultra M

reviews.title: No Frills!
reviews.text: We flew Nanjing to Kunming then Kunming to Bangkok. The attraction was an overnight lay over of 18 hours in Kunming which gave us an opportunity to see a little of Kunming. Flights were cheap. Both flights late in departing, as expected! No frills onboard - no entertainment, no food barring a bread roll sandwich on the international flight. Booking instructions were to allow three hours in Kunming for check-in; the check-in desk only opened two hours prior to departure. The biggest frustration however was being unable to check in to our final destination from Nanjing - we had to retrieve our checked in baggage in Kunming and to check in a second time for our connecting flight to Bangkok. This is standard practice in China with Chinese airlines and we knew this would happen so we accept this. In the final analysis we got to our intended destination, enjoyed a peaceful night in the airport hotel and then had very pleasant few hours in Kunming. So no real complaints
reviews.author: WildHamish

reviews.title: No issues
reviews.text: OK budget carrier. The flight departed and arrived on schedule, but used a remote gate which required taking a bus to the aircraft. This was a short flight; no food or entertainment. Ticket was cheap, so expect fees for checked luggage. Crew was friendly and operated the flight safely.
reviews.author: charlieflys

reviews.title: Not bad for short haul flights in China
reviews.text: Took Lucky Air for the first time from Kunming to Xishuangbanna. Although the flight is very short, it was worth the money as the whole journey was very comfortable.
reviews.author: Oren Y

reviews.title: Not so Lucky for Me
reviews.text: I was under the impression that domestic flights within China had a 20 kilo luggage allowance. Not so with Lucky Air it would seem. Presenting my 19.2 kilo suitcase at check-in, I was asked for 140 Yuan as my luggage was 'overweight'. I didn't get to learn what the allowance actually is - just that as I had purchased a 'cheap ticket' I would need to pay (in cash) in order to proceed. Incidentally, the payment had to be made at a separate desk - meaning that having paid I then had the choice of going back to the front of my original line (where my luggage was still held) or joining the back of it again. I chose to go directly to the front of the line.
reviews.author: Andrew C

reviews.title: Good flight, no complaints, despite the flippant name!
reviews.text: Please also see my report on "Okay Air". This was the second oddly named airline we flew by, in China. And once again, I was slightly put out. After all, flying is a serious business, and flippancy in any form seems out of place. But, once again, I need not have bothered. Fantastic flight. Very smooth and very soft touch-down. Very clean aircraft, an almost brand new 737-800. Cabin crew very polite, cheerful, and helpful. Being a budget airline, we did not get anything except a small water bottle. I cannot comment on "value for money" as we paid an all-inclusive fee to our tour operator for our four week trip to China. On the whole, a very enjoyable flight, and I would have no hesitation in flying by this airline.
reviews.author: Alex J

reviews.title: NEW DESTINATION BALI
reviews.text: General speaking, it is a comfortable flying experience, new aircrafe boeing 737-800 .the space is big enough，Flight was on time，but the only one thing is baggage check in can't be transfered one stop in Kunming ,you need to check in again in Nanning. Transfer time a little bit busy . Which made me very nervous, but it is a good flight from Kunming to Bali ,we don't need to transfer one night in other city , Good we can arrive in day time .Saved a lot time!
reviews.author: ZHUXIAOLEI

reviews.title: Lucky Day
reviews.text: After having read the other reviews which weren't too complimentary about Lucky Air I felt that, to be fair, I should review my flight with them back in June 2015 (ignore my selection below as it does not go beyond Sept 2015). My wife and I had absolutely no problems with Lucky. Maybe we were just lucky? Anyhow, to be specific, check-in was done without problems, the flight was smooth (short stopover in Wuhan) the service was friendly and efficient and we arrived pretty much on time. No complaints from me and I would recommend them.
reviews.author: David C

reviews.title: Flight was on time, but otherwise felt rather unlucky
reviews.text: I found the flight attendants to be very rude. Also, insisted that mobile phones be powered off the entire flight. I guess they never heard of flight mode. If they saw one, they would hover over until the phone was turned off. Food and drink had to be purchased. There was not entertainment on 2+ hour flight. Big long sales pitch as they tried to sell overpriced junk during the flight. The flight attendants could not speak English. Other Chinese airlines the passengers have been queuing up nicely, but at this airline it was the classic Chinese mob with people cutting in line and pushing there way in.
reviews.author: Harring10

reviews.title: delay and baggage fees galore!
reviews.text: arriving at the counter, we each (the 3 of us) put our moderate suitcases on the belt. the agent tagged them and told us to go pay for luggage fee at the other counter and come back. the luggage fee wound up being more than one ticket! $498.RMB! the flight as cramped and late but that's China. on our way back we ditched the flight and took Uber from Dali to Kunming. comfortable and cheaper when split 3 ways!
reviews.author: trvlkrsten

reviews.title: Worst airline ever ! Absolutely Dangerous
reviews.text: Absolutely Dangerously Airline. I was sitting overwing, and could see that Wing was filled with snow, and they departed without deicing. Also during flight I noticed that the whole cockpit windows was covered in news papers. Aircraft was dirty, and several seats was broken. It was a horrible trip
reviews.author: Henrik Ottosen
